extracted_data.name: Tejas C. Waghmare
extracted_data.summary: Data Analyst with hands-on experience in SQL, Power BI, Advanced Excel, and Python, backed by Microsoft certifications (PL-300, DP-600). Skilled in data cleaning, modeling, and building interactive dashboards that turn raw data into clear, actionable business insights. Engineering background with project work across pricing, sales, and profitability analysis, ready to add value in any industry.

experience.title: Data Analyst Intern
bullets: Cleaned, transformed, and prepared datasets to ensure data quality before analysis and reporting.
Built interactive Power BI dashboards using data modeling, DAX measures, and KPIs to surface trends and insights.

Applied this training to the NYC Airbnb Data Analysis & Business Intelligence project: cleaned and modeled 30,259 listings (SQL, Power Query) and delivered a Power BI dashboard on borough-level pricing, occupancy, and revenue.

experience.title: Project Engineer
bullets: Supported onsite project execution, monitored work progress, and coordinated activities to ensure alignment with project requirements and timelines.

Utilized advanced Microsoft Excel (PivotTables, XLOOKUP, data cleaning, data validation, and KPI tracking) to organize project data, maintain trackers, analyze operational information, and support reporting.

experience.title: Graduate Trainee Engineer
bullets: Gained hands-on experience in industrial sensors, PLC programming, robotics, and automation systems, including sensor data acquisition and industrial process monitoring.
Collected and analyzed sensor data using Excel to identify trends and support data-driven decisions, while gaining exposure to AI/ML concepts and predictive analytics in smart manufacturing.

projects.title: NYC Airbnb Data Analysis & Business Intelligence
projects.tools: SQL, Power BI, DAX, Power Query
bullets: Analyzed 30,259 listings across 16,441 hosts using SQL and Power Query to uncover borough-level pricing, occupancy, and revenue drivers across $389.3M in estimated market value.

Built an interactive Power BI dashboard (custom DAX measures, data model) showing Manhattan led with $205M revenue (52.7% of total) and the highest average daily rate ($366), giving hosts and property managers pricing benchmarks.

projects.title: Bakery Sales, Profitability & Waste Analysis
projects.tools: Excel, Power Pivot, PivotTables, Data Modeling
bullets: Analyzed 16,569 transactions (2023–2024) across 3 stores using a star-schema model and Excel dashboards to track revenue, profit, discount, and waste KPIs.
Found waste cost equaled 40% of revenue and deep discounts drove a−6.7% margin; recommended capping discounts near 5% and cutting waste 20–25% to return to profit.

projects.title: Amazon Sales Performance Dashboard
projects.tools: Power BI, DAX, Data Modeling, Geo Mapping
bullets: Developed a 3-page interactive dashboard analyzing 50K+ orders and $32.8M revenue across 6 categories and 5 global regions.
Identified Beauty as the top revenue category and found discounts were spread evenly across categories, indicating scope for a targeted, category-level discount strategy.
